quotations: "We expanded our capacity consideration to see outside Arizona, whether we can get another chance to expand our capacity," said C.C. Wei during the company's earnings call with financial analysts and investors. "Texas is one [of our options]. We sent the teams to Texas to do all the evaluation. We also talked to one of our customers, who is trying to build a fab, Terafab, let me be more specific."

"We are still in discussion," Wei replied when asked whether TSMC is not becoming a part of the Terafab project. "Let me say that. […] Either way, it will be possible, but the fab has to be run by TSMC."
